title: Log-BUN–creatinine coupling does not reliably improve cross-cycle prediction of digit-symbol performance
abstract: A prespecified product of source-standardized log blood urea nitrogen and log creatinine was added to a flexible conventional renal/demographic model for digit-symbol substitution score. Training used NHANES2011–12 adults60+ (n=1290), with frozen transfer to separately recruited NHANES2013–14 adults (n=1505). Survey-weighted target MSE decreased from160.936594 to160.763116, a0.108% reduction. Joint source–target survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval for MSE gain was[-13.322872,0.959521] points²; MAE worsened. Source cross-validation, regularization sensitivity, and delete-one checks do not support a reliable increment. These are same-survey cross-cycle cohorts, not independent clinical institutions. This negative feature test does not exclude kidney–brain physiology or validate a diagnostic surrogate.
